current_correlation.claim_limit: Current Goal/thread and task-local receipts are a dashboard correlation surface, not role, runtime, proof, acceptance, or human authority.

checked_existing_surfaces.claim_limit: The existing adapter validates task-local correlation but has no durable cursor/checkpoint ledger.
